R0214.title: Digital Human Deepfake
R0214.definition: Attackers use AI technology to clone others' appearance and voice to create digital avatars for fraud, impersonation or personality rights infringement.

references.title: Building a strong security barrier for digital humans
Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA)

R0214.description:
Digital human deepfakes use generative AI to clone appearance, voice, facial expression, and speaking style for impersonation. Attackers may pose as support agents, streamers, executives, or relatives to commit fraud or manipulate opinion.

Real-time generation lowers the cost of convincing impersonation. Businesses need liveness checks, provenance signals, identity verification, and behavior-based anomaly detection.
R0214.influence: Deepfaked digital humans can impersonate trusted people or brands, increasing fraud success and reputational harm.
